newsitem.title: USA: Continental Airlines matches fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Continental Airlines matches fare sale.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said Monday it will offer Thanksgiving holiday fare discounts up to 50 percent in certain domestic and international markets, matching fare cuts announced earlier by rivals.
Continental said the round-trip tickets must be purchased at least one day prior to departure for travel originating November 24, 25 or 28 and returning November 28 or 29.
Trans World Airlines Inc, AMR Corp, Delta Air Lines Inc and America West Airlines Inc previously announced fare reductions.
